name: Claude-Melusina
shortDescription: A shell and Claude Code, streamed to the browser, running out of the grain's own /var.
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Claude-Melusina turns the grain sandbox's constraints into its design. /var is the only writable, persistent mount, and it is exec-capable, so the Claude Code binary and its loader are staged there once and survive restarts and package upgrades. A grain cannot allocate a PTY, so the shell is a pure-Go POSIX interpreter whose pipes stream to the browser over the WebSession response's streamed body arm, journalled to /var so a dropped connection or a grain restart costs nothing but a reconnect. A grain has no network, so model egress is a PowerBox HTTP-out capability granted from the setup screen and fronted by a loopback proxy.
